title: FerroAI guides discovery of a ferroelectric composition with high dielectric response
summary: FerroAI, trained on text-mined phase-transition data, predicted composition–temperature phase behavior and a morphotropic phase boundary in a Zr/Hf co-doped barium titanate–BCT system. Researchers synthesized and characterized compositions near the predicted boundary. The x = 0.3 sample showed dielectric constant 9,535 at 1 kHz and 11,051 at 100 Hz at the transition temperature. The frequency-specific measured values should not be interchanged.
ai_technology: FerroAI deep learning model; NLP-extracted phase-transition dataset
organization: Tongji University; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
